world.era: high fantasy: a war-torn continent of Emarion with the Realm of Light and Shadow, Lumnos
world.setting: Emarion, a continent divided by war between northern mortal armies and southern rebel Guardians of the Everflame; the Crowns of Lumnos; the Descended and the Kindred
world.register: epic fantasy, armoured soldiers, magic, temples, ancient bonds

luther.name: Luther Corbois
luther.role: Diem's devoted mate, a commander whose magic nearly levels the forest
luther.look: a broad-shouldered man in his late twenties, dark hair, dark leather armour over a grey tunic, a sword belt, grim focused expression

teller.name: Teller
teller.role: Dean's mortal brother, sitting alone, grieving a bond forced on him by his mother
teller.look: a lean young man in his twenties, sandy hair, worn travel cloak over a plain shirt, tired eyes

taran.name: Taran
taran.role: Diem's brother, one of the Crowns of Lumnos
taran.look: a young man with a severe, watchful face, short dark hair, a dark formal coat with a silver clasp

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.role: the host voice that frames the argument
narrator.look: a neutral narrator figure, seen only as a presence

forest.look: a scorched forest where a magical battle levels the trees

shore.look: the coast of Arboros at the edge of the sea

stage.look: the temple on Corel where the Everflame ritual and the old god's law are stated

horizon.look: the Realm of Light and Shadow, Lumnos, seen across a wide sky

objects.why: the war engulfing Emarion; the northern army raised to wipe out the Descended
the Everflame and the rebellion it kindles
the bond that chains two souls against their own choice
the mother who manipulated her children from behind the scenes
children used as a shield for a mother's endgame
the golden compass, a physical sign of the psychological hostage situation
the brothers and the mother bound by blood
the mate bond that erases a person's own choices

spine.claim: A forced bond ties two people together while a war engulfs the continent.
The mortal army and the Guardians rise; the bonded Crowns are pushed into alliance.
Luther's magic nearly destroys the forest, and a manipulative mother's plan comes to light.
The old god states the cosmic law: a life for a life, and the cost falls on the bonded.
Diem's third choice leaves a terrible price that someone has to pay.

signatureObjects.name: The Everflame
signatureObjects.why: the sacred flame the Guardians guard and the rebellion rallies around; no shared fire icon depicts it
